pairings.title: Kasba Ganpati and Lal Mahal
pairings.suits: A central-Pune history stop when you are already near Kasba Peth.
pairings.assumption: State tourism places Kasba Ganpati near Lal Mahal. This guide has not timed the walk or checked either entrance.
pairings.limit: No hours, tickets, or queue advice. If one stop is closed or crowded, the other is still listed on its own page.

pairings.title: Camp bakery, Camp garden
pairings.suits: A Camp-side outing that pairs a bakery counter with a large garden.
pairings.assumption: Both publish Camp addresses: Kayani on East Street, and Empress Botanical Garden near the racecourse. The distance between them has not been measured.
pairings.limit: Kayani lists Monday to Saturday hours and does not list Sunday. The garden lists a morning-to-evening span and does not name closed days. Reconfirm both. Either stop stands alone.

pairings.title: Khadakwasla, then the fort page
pairings.suits: Someone already heading toward the dam who wants the district’s note on what lies further out.
pairings.assumption: The district says Sinhagad is a few kilometres further up the road from Khadakwasla. This guide has not driven that road and does not choose a mode of travel.
pairings.limit: This is not a trek plan. The fort entry does not confirm that the road, gates, or trails are open. Do not add a night visit or a monsoon climb. The dam entry is not a swimming stop. If access is unclear, skip the fort.
